automation_subtitle: Run a command, or call a webhook, when something happens on this host.
automation_empty: No hooks yet. Add one to run something when a stream starts, a client pairs, or a game exits.
automation_hook_help: Pick the event, then what should happen. A trailing .* matches every event in that domain.
automation_field_on_help: The event that fires this hook — the same names the host publishes on its event stream.
automation_action_run_help: Runs detached, as the host user, with the event JSON on stdin and PF_EVENT_* in the environment.
automation_action_webhook_help: The event JSON is POSTed to this URL.
automation_field_hmac_help: The signing secret. The request carries a signature the receiver can check.
automation_field_filter: Only for a specific client or game
automation_filter_app_help: Matches the id the event carries, like steam:570 — the title is shown to help you find it.
automation_filter_none: No match — it will still be saved as typed.
automation_confirm_body: These commands run on this machine, as the host user, whenever their event fires. Confirm with the console password.
stats_stop_failed: Couldn't stop the capture — it may not have been saved
plugin_origin_untrusted_hint: Your browser hasn't accepted this host's certificate for the plugin port. Open it in a tab, then come back.
plugin_origin_unavailable_hint: The plugin port couldn't be opened, so plugin interfaces stay off. Set PUNKTFUNK_UI_PLUGIN_PORT and restart.
plugin_offline_hint: Start the scripting runner, then retry.
audio_mic_withheld: The microphone endpoint is carrying game audio — install Steam so the host can mint its own microphone (Steam never has to run).
audio_last_resort: Game audio is on a degraded fallback endpoint and may be silent until an output device appears.
activity_empty: Nothing yet — events show up here as they happen on the host.
activity_ring_note: This list starts fresh on every page load — the host keeps no activity log.
connect_help: Type this address into a punktfunk client, or open the link on a device that already has one.
host_power_confirm_body: Every active stream ends first. Confirm with your console password.
host_power_sent: {action} — sent. The host is on its way down.
host_compositors_help: Backends this host can drive a virtual output on. Pass an id to a client's --compositor flag.
host_gpus_help: Automatic picks the best GPU. A change applies to the next session.
gpu_missing_warning: The preferred GPU “{name}” is not present — automatic selection is used instead.
gpu_env_note: PUNKTFUNK_RENDER_ADAPTER={value} pins the GPU while in automatic mode.
gpu_encoder_pin_warning: PUNKTFUNK_ENCODER={value} pins a {vendor} encoder, but the next session's GPU is “{name}” — remove the stale pin from host.env.
host_conflicts_title: Another game-streaming server is active on this machine
host_conflicts_help: Another server holds Punktfunk's ports, so whichever started first answers. Stop it, then restart.
host_displays_help: Pick a preset, or Custom to set options directly. A change applies to the next session.
display_game_session_help: Dedicated boots the game straight into its own session at your resolution.
display_ddc_help: Stops the stutter some setups get with a dark monitor. If one stays dark, press its power button.
display_pnp_help: Stops a standby monitor or TV waking mid-stream. They come back when the stream ends.
display_edid_help: Stops the rhythmic stutter some setups get while a monitor sleeps. Undone when the stream ends.
clients_rename_body: Moonlight clients all identify themselves the same way, so this name is yours to set. Leave it empty to remove it.
pairing_idle: No pairing in progress. Start pairing from a Moonlight client, then enter its PIN here.
pairing_waiting: A client is waiting to pair. Enter the PIN it shows:
pairing_ceremony_select: Several clients are waiting. Pick the one whose PIN you are entering — the PIN goes only to that device:
pairing_pin_sent: PIN sent. If it's correct, the client finishes pairing and appears under Paired devices below.
pairing_failed: Couldn't submit the PIN — check it's correct and that the client is still waiting to pair.
pairing_native_desc: Show a one-time PIN here, then enter it in your Punktfunk app to pair this device.
pairing_native_disabled: The native host isn't running. Start it with `serve --native` to pair Punktfunk devices.
pairing_native_bound_hint: Only this device can use the PIN. Any other device that knocks is turned away without spending it.
pairing_native_enter: Enter this PIN on your device:
pairing_native_unpair_body: It will need to pair again to connect.
pairing_native_unpair_all_body: Every paired device — punktfunk/1 and Moonlight alike — will need to pair again to connect, and anything streaming right now is disconnected.
pairing_pending_desc: These devices tried to connect. Approving one from your own network pairs it immediately — no PIN needed. One that knocked from the internet needs a PIN bound to it.
pairing_pending_wan_hint: Knocked from the internet, where its name proves nothing. Arm a PIN bound to it, then pass the PIN on.
pairing_pending_name_desc: {name} — fingerprint {fp}. It is stored under the name you leave here.
pairing_approve_desc: Choose what this device may do and for how long. Approving pairs it immediately.
pairing_approve_known_note: This device was paired before — its previous access is pre-filled.
pairing_password_help: A paired device can control this machine, so the password is needed again.
access_grant_power_caption: Sleep, restart or shut down the host. Keyboard access can already reach this via the desktop.
access_edit_desc: What {name} may do on this host — and for how long.
library_sources_help: Turn one off to hide its games on every device. Nothing is deleted.
library_process_help: How the host recognizes the running title. Without a hint it can't see it exit or end it on disconnect.
library_field_exe_help: Full path of the game's binary on the host, e.g. /usr/bin/eden.
library_field_install_dir_help: Any process started from inside this directory counts, e.g. a Wine or Proton title.
library_field_process_name_help: The weakest signal: the process's own name, e.g. eden.
library_field_command_help: Optional. The command the host runs to launch this title.
library_field_password_help: A command runs on the host as you. Confirm your console password to save it.
library_field_platform_help: The system this title runs on, e.g. PS2, Xbox 360, SNES, PC.
library_field_tags_help: Comma-separated labels for organizing, e.g. co-op, kids.
library_empty_add_source: Add a game source below to see your installed games here.
library_metadata_help: Fills covers and details a game is missing, in this order. Use for every game also replaces its own art.
library_metadata_replace_help: This source's art replaces covers a game already has. Details still only fill gaps.
library_media_no_sources: No Art & Metadata source is running. Add one under Library.
library_field_from_editable: {source} fills this until you type your own.
library_source_settings_own_page: {source} keeps its settings on its own page.
library_migrate_title: Game sources are moving to plugins
library_migrate_help: Each launcher becomes its own add-on. Install one and it takes over; your games keep their tiles.
library_provider_purge_body: This only removes them from the library.
library_entry_managed_note: {source} keeps this title's details. Change them there; they come back on its next sync.
library_entry_missing: This title is no longer in the library.
library_entry_leave_body: Your changes to this title will be lost.
library_entry_no_details: Its source sent no details for this title.
library_media_portrait_help: Tall cover, 2:3. The shelf tile. An http(s) URL or a file on the host.
library_media_hero_help: Wide banner behind the title. An http(s) URL or a file on the host.
library_media_header_help: Landscape capsule, about 460×215. An http(s) URL or a file on the host.
library_media_logo_help: The title's logo, ideally on a transparent background.
library_entry_icon_help: Drawn on a launcher tile that has no cover art.
library_entry_launch_replaced: A command typed below replaces it.
library_entry_prep_help: Run before launch and undone after. Set through the API.
library_entry_plugin_save_failed: Couldn't save {plugin}'s settings for this title — {issue}
plugin_form_json_hint: These settings don't fit a simple form, so edit them as JSON. They're checked before saving.
plugin_form_path_read: Saving gives {plugin} read access to the folders entered here.
plugin_form_path_write: Saving gives {plugin} read and write access to the folders entered here.
common_unauthorized: Session expired — redirecting to sign in…
login_subtitle: Enter the management password to continue. Don't know what to do?
login_throttled: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again {when}.
settings_logout_failed: Couldn't sign you out — you're still signed in. Try again.
troubleshooting_subtitle: What this host knows about its own health, and the log stream underneath it.
diag_all_ok: Everything this host can check looks healthy.
diag_unavailable: This host is older than the console and can't report health checks. Update the host to see them.
diag_hide_inapplicable: Hide the ones that don't apply here
diag_relogin_required: Log out and back in afterwards
logs_sources_none: No sources selected — pick at least one above.
logs_devices_empty: No device has sent logs yet — use “Send logs to host” in a client's host menu.
logs_empty_plugins: No plugin output yet. Plugins log here once the plugin runner is running.
logs_empty: No log entries match — adjust the filter or wait for host activity.
logs_dropped: Some entries were evicted before they could be fetched
logs_stalled: Couldn't fetch new log lines — showing the last ones received
client_logs_delete_body: The device can send a fresh one at any time.
stats_subtitle: Record a session's pipeline timings and review them as graphs.
stats_capture_desc: Arm capture, run a session, then stop to save a recording. Sampling runs at the host's aggregation boundary — no per-frame overhead.
stats_live_window: Showing the last {count} samples. The saved recording keeps everything.
stats_live_waiting: Armed — waiting for the first samples. Start a session to begin recording.
stats_latency_desc: Per-stage pipeline time, stacked, against one frame at the stream's rate. The line is the host's whole share, capture to sent.
stats_recordings_empty: No recordings yet. Start a capture to record one.
stats_truncated_note: This capture hit the sample cap: later samples were dropped and the start kept.
stats_health_none: This path records no loss counters.
store_subtitle: Browse the plugin catalog, install and remove plugins, and choose which catalogs this host trusts.
store_tier_verified_hint: From the built-in unom catalog — unom reviewed this exact package.
store_tier_external_hint: Pinned and integrity-checked, but curated by someone other than unom. Nobody at unom reviewed this code.
store_tier_unverified_hint: Installed from a raw package spec. No catalog, no review — nobody checked this code.
store_tier_cli_hint: Installed from the command line, so the host has no record of where it came from.
store_all_sources_failed: Couldn't fetch any catalog ({sources}). The store may not be empty — check the Sources tab.
store_empty: No plugins in the catalog yet.
store_runner_help: The service every plugin runs inside. Disabling it stops all plugins at once without uninstalling anything.
store_runner_not_installed: The plugin runner isn't installed on this host, so plugins can't start.
store_runner_banner: The plugin runner is switched off — plugins won't start until you enable it.
store_uninstall_body: You can install it again from the catalog.
store_update_no_entry: That plugin isn't in any catalog right now — refresh the sources and try again.
store_update_all_body: Each one is installed at its catalog version, one after another — the host takes a single package operation at a time. The plugin runner restarts after each.
store_update_all_external_note: Some of these come from catalogs you added yourself ({sources}). unom has not reviewed that code; it is pinned and integrity-checked, but it will run on this host with the plugin runner's privileges.
store_update_all_skipped: Not included: {names}. Either no catalog carries them, or this host can't run the version on offer.
store_update_all_stopped: Stopped after a failure — {done} updated, {left} not attempted. Retry them from the rows below.
store_sources_help: The built-in unom catalog is always present. Every other source is one you added.
store_source_remove_body: Plugins already installed from it stay installed.
store_source_builtin_locked: The built-in unom catalog can't be removed.
store_field_source_key_help: An ed25519:… key. With a key set, the host only accepts a signed index from this source.
store_add_source_failed: Couldn't save the source — check the name and the URL
store_source_trust_body: Everything you install from “{name}” is code unom has not reviewed. It runs on this host with the plugin runner's privileges. Only add a catalog whose operator you trust.
store_source_trust_unsigned: Without a public key the host can't tell whether this index was tampered with in transit.
store_install_verified_body: Version {version} from the built-in unom catalog. unom reviewed this exact package.
store_install_external_body: Version {version} comes from “{source}”, a catalog you added yourself.
store_install_external_note: unom has not reviewed this code. The package is pinned and integrity-checked, but it will run on this host with the plugin runner's privileges.
store_busy: The host is already installing or removing a plugin. Try again once it's finished.
store_spec_lead: This installs code straight from a package registry. It is in no catalog, nobody has reviewed it, and it will run on this host with the plugin runner's privileges — the same access it has to your files and your session.
store_spec_permanent: A plugin installed this way stays marked Unverified for as long as it is installed.
store_spec_confirm_field: Type the package spec again to confirm
store_spec_checkbox: I understand that this runs unreviewed code with operator privileges.
store_spec_password_help: Running unreviewed code needs the password again — a browser session on its own can't do this.
store_job_restarting: The plugin runner is restarting — the sidebar catches up in a moment.
store_job_lost_hint: The host restarted while it ran. Check the Installed tab to see whether it finished.
games_untracked_note: This title exposes nothing the host can recognize its process by, so quitting it won't end the session
games_closing_in: Its client is gone — closing in {time} unless it comes back
games_end_all_waiting_confirm: This game has no id the host can single out, so ending it now ends all {count} games waiting to close.
action_stop_session_all_confirm: The host has one stop, and it ends every live session — all {count} of them, not just this one.
session_game_title: When a game or a session ends
session_game_help: These settings govern the game. Keep alive above governs the display.
session_game_on_exit_help: Quitting the game returns the client to its own library.
session_game_end_game_help: Only a game this host launched for the session — never one you started yourself.
session_game_always_warning: Closing a game costs whatever it hasn't saved. A dropped client gets the reconnect window below first.
session_game_new_launch_help: Closing the last game frees the display, sound and controller — and costs its unsaved work.
session_game_new_launch_scope: Only games this host launched for the same device — never the title you are starting.
session_game_grace_help: How long a vanished client has to come back. Reconnecting cancels it.
session_game_nested_note: On a gamescope session the game lives as long as the display, which Keep alive decides.
display_monitor_env_locked: Pinned by PUNKTFUNK_CAPTURE_MONITOR on this host — unset it to choose here.
display_monitor_missing_hint: This host has no screen with this name, so no client can start a session.
display_monitor_missing_warning: The screen this host is set to stream isn't connected to it any more, so every session fails. Pick a screen below, or the virtual screen.
update_not_published: Nothing has been published to the {channel} channel yet. The check itself is working — there's just no release to compare against.
update_stale: The update feed hasn't changed in over 45 days — checks succeed but nothing new arrives. If that seems wrong, check this host's connectivity to git.unom.io.
update_disabled: Update checks are disabled on this host (PUNKTFUNK_UPDATE_CHECK=0).
update_apply_ready: Version {version} can be installed from here — the host downloads, verifies, and restarts itself.
update_apply_confirm_body: Confirm with the console password. The host will restart at the end; this page reconnects by itself.
update_apply_force_warning: A streaming session is live right now — updating will drop it (whoever is playing gets cut off). If that stream is how you're viewing this page, you'll lose it too.
update_apply_throttled: Too many attempts — wait a moment and try again.
update_apply_timeout: The host hasn't come back yet. It may still be installing — if this persists, check the service on the machine and the installer log under the punktfunk data directory (logs\update-*.log).
update_stage_reconnecting: Waiting for the host to come back…
update_result_staged: Update to {to} is staged — reboot this host to finish.
update_result_noop: Your package source had nothing newer yet — try again in a few minutes.
update_result_noop_source: Nothing to rebuild — this host is already on the newest build.
update_opt_in: To enable one-click updates from here, run this once on the host (then log out and back in):
library_field_role_help: Shows it in the Launchers row above your games instead of in the grid. It still starts and stops the same way.
library_field_audio_help: Which clients on a shared display get the sound. Everyone by default; the Session card can still mute one.
nav_devices_hint: Pair a device, see what is paired
nav_displays_hint: What happens to your screens when a device connects
nav_library_hint: Games and where they come from
nav_troubleshooting_hint: Health checks and the log stream
nav_automation_hint: Run something when this host does something
settings_navigation_help: A pinned plugin page gets its own entry in the sidebar.
plugin_installed_toast: {name} added — open it under Plugins, or pin it.
settings_reach_lan: This console is reachable from your local network at {url}, never from the internet — anyone on that network can open the sign-in page.
settings_reach_change: Set PUNKTFUNK_UI_BIND=127.0.0.1 in host.env and restart the console to keep it to this machine.
display_says_screen_extend: its own screen next to your monitors
display_says_screen_exclusive: the only screen — your monitors turn off
display_says_screen_auto: a screen chosen to fit this host
display_says_second_separate: A second device gets its own screen.
display_says_second_join: A second device shares the screen.
display_says_second_reject: A second device is told the host is busy.
display_q_remember_help: Lets the desktop keep scaling per device.
display_q_max: Up to this many screens at once
display_arrange_hint: Drag a streamed screen to place it.
display_stream_virtual: Give each device its own screen
nav_controllers_hint: The pad the host holds, lit by what it receives
controllers_intro: What the host receives, not what the client thinks it sent.
controllers_no_session: Nothing is streaming, so the host holds no controllers right now.
controllers_no_pads: This session hasn't sent a controller yet.
controllers_stream_failed: Couldn't watch this session's controllers — reload the page to try again.
controllers_log_empty: Press something on the pad and it shows up here.
host_settings_intro: Changes apply to the next stream unless a setting says otherwise.
setting_gamestream_hint: Lets Moonlight pair and stream. Turn it on for trusted networks only.
setting_webtransport_hint: Lets the web client stream in a browser.
setting_clipboard_hint: Each device still turns it on for itself.
setting_host_name_hint: Shown in every client. Leave it blank to use the computer's name.
setting_chroma_444_hint: Sharper text where the device and GPU support it.
setting_max_fps_hint: Caps how fast the game renders, not the stream. 0 means no limit.
setting_audio_voice_chat_hint: On the host keeps friends in a call from hearing themselves.
setting_audio_voice_apps_hint: Apps added to the built-in voice chat list.
host_settings_restarted: Punktfunk restarted. Every setting is in effect.
host_settings_restart_slow: Punktfunk hasn't come back yet. Check the host.
setting_gamestream_encrypt_hint: How Moonlight clients are offered encryption.
setting_gamestream_adapt_hint: Eases the bitrate and raises error correction when Moonlight reports loss.
setting_chacha20_hint: Lets devices without AES hardware pick a faster cipher.
setting_webtransport_origins_hint: Pages allowed to stream from this host. Empty allows any.
setting_encoder_hint: Auto picks the best encoder for this GPU.
setting_portal_cursor_mode_hint: How the desktop portal hands over the mouse pointer.
setting_vulkan_encode_hint: Off falls back to VA-API on AMD and Intel.
setting_direct_capture_hint: Captures the compositor directly instead of through the desktop portal.
setting_lazy_capture_hint: Lets the stream ask for each frame on compositors that support it.
setting_kwin_paced_hint: Turn it on if KWin drops frames while the pointer moves.
setting_pyrowave_bpp_hint: 1.6 looks clean. Lower saves bandwidth and softens the picture.
setting_pyrowave_max_mbps_hint: Caps every PyroWave stream. 0 means no cap.
setting_instant_replay_pause_hint: Instant Replay shares the video encoder with the stream. Auto pauses it only while a stream falls behind.
setting_audio_hires_hint: Devices that ask for it get uncompressed audio.
setting_pad_audio_hint: Sends game audio to the speaker and haptics of supported controllers.
setting_audio_redundancy_hint: Sends audio twice on a lossy link. Auto does it only when needed.
setting_gamepad_hint: Used when a device doesn't pick one.
setting_pen_hint: Pressure and tilt from tablets that send them.
setting_steam_gadget_hint: Presents Steam Deck controls as a USB device. Auto uses it on SteamOS.
setting_dualsense_usbip_hint: Gives each DualSense a real sound card for its speaker.
setting_gamescope_attach_hint: Mirrors this box's screen at its own resolution instead of giving the device a display of its own.
setting_gamescope_hdr_hint: Off keeps Game Mode sessions in SDR.
setting_gamescope_managed_hint: Starts Game Mode for the device even where it wouldn't be picked.
setting_gamescope_vrr_hint: Lets Game Mode draw a frame when the game does.
setting_gamescope_sdr_nits_hint: How bright SDR content looks inside an HDR stream.
setting_gamescope_refresh_rates_hint: More rates, in Hz, a device can switch to during a session.
setting_gamescope_steam_hint: Starts every Game Mode session with Steam integration, not only Steam games.
setting_gamescope_splash_hint: Shows a splash so a new session has a picture at once.
setting_gamescope_isolate_hint: Gives each session its own input and audio.
setting_gamescope_grab_cursor_hint: Locks the pointer to the game. Menus that expect a free pointer break.
setting_gamescope_bind_hint: Puts Punktfunk's gamescope in place of the system one for Game Mode.
setting_session_watch_hint: Keeps streaming when the host switches between Game Mode and the desktop.
setting_mdns_hint: Announces the host on the local network. Off means adding it by address.
setting_idle_timeout_ms_hint: How long a silent device keeps its session before the host lets go.
setting_update_check_hint: Asks the update server about new versions.
setting_update_apply_hint: Lets the console install updates. Off still shows them.
